The Alliance Integration Lead is responsible for managing the lifecycle of integrations between Vates VMS and technologies within the Vates ecosystem, with the aim of building complete, coherent and sustainable solutions that meet customer needs. At the intersection of Product Management, solution integration and partner engineering, the Alliance Integration Lead works closely with technology partners, Vates Product and Engineering teams, as well as Sales, Presales and customers. The role involves analyzing market and customer needs, identifying relevant technologies and partners, defining integration requirements, and driving their implementation. The Alliance Integration Lead oversees projects from initial requirements definition through validation, solution delivery and ongoing lifecycle management. The Alliance Integration Lead also acts as the technical point of reference for third-party technologies within the Vates ecosystem. They support Sales, Presales and Solutions Experts when customer projects involve partner technologies, providing the technical information and support required to help successfully deliver these solutions. Your Responsibilities The Vates integration portfolio You will maintain, develop and promote a portfolio covering dozens of technology partners and integrations across the Vates ecosystem. For Each Strategic Technology Or Partner, You Will Understand Which use cases are or should be supported and under which conditions; The maturity of the integration and important capability gaps; The target integration level and what is required to reach it. You will maintain a clear and current view of compatibility and help prioritize where Vates should invest engineering and alliance resources. The scope extends from silicon to workloads: compute, storage, backup and data protection, networking, cybersecurity, observability, automation, VDI, cloud-native infrastructure, enterprise applications and AI workloads. You will own their technical lifecycle. Starting from a customer requirement, strategic opportunity or partner initiative, you will: Define use cases, requirements and specifications; Establish responsibilities between Vates and the partner; Coordinate implementation across engineering organizations; Validate and document the resulting solution; Manage compatibility and upgrades as Vates or partner products evolve. You are free to work 100% remotely or come on-site occasionally, depending on your preferences. Benefits Meal vouchers Health insurance coverage funded at 50% by the company Benefits provided by the Works Council (employee discounts, cinema tickets, etc.) Employee savings plan (PEE) Profit-sharing scheme Annual bonus 100% remote work As part of our diversity and inclusion policy, this position is open to all candidates, regardless of gender. The ideal candidate profile is oriented towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Systems Engineering or a related technical field. You have solid experience (several years) in infrastructure engineering or technical product management and are comfortable with the various layers of modern data center infrastructure. Experience in the fields of technology alliances, independent software vendors (ISVs), infrastructure solution providers, or open-source communities would be particularly relevant. Fluent in English and French.
